text:
nico: quick follow-up after the overnight frag run. we see slow buildup of internal slack w/ lots of tiny allocs from the metadata service. logs: /var/log/frag/overnight.log
anya: yeah, looks like repeated small allocs land in already-fragged slabs, making compaction less effective.
kevin: thought: instead of immediate compaction we should compute a compact_affinity score per-slab and only spend budget on high-affinity slabs. avoids wasting CPU on low ROI compactions.
sana: agree. also add a small per-tenant compaction budget so noisy tenants can't exhaust host compaction bandwidth. allocator keeps a token bucket per-tenant.
nico: token rules? refill by footprint? topo: refill_rate = footprint_mb / 60s as a starting point.
anya: sketch: compact_affinity = expected_frag_reduction / compact_cost. expected_frag_reduction subtracts pinned_fraction in slab. then sort candidate slabs by affinity and pop until token budget exhausted.
kevin: runtime interaction: compaction can evict prefix-backed pages and cause cache misses. propose runtime exposes prefix_density(slab) and allocator penalizes slabs with high prefix density unless emergency.
sana: alternative: allow allocator to compact but emit a rewarm_event so runtime can prefetch a tiny neighborhood on first miss. need rewarm budget too.
nico: agree. keep budgets simple initially: tenant_compact_tokens & tenant_rewarm_tokens. both refill proportional to footprint. host-level bandwidth guard prevents rewarm+compact IO storms.
anya: metrics to add: per-tenant token_level, compact_cycles, slabs_compacted, rewarm_attempts, rewarm_hits, slab_affinity_top10.
kevin: operational endpoint: /debug/allocator/top-affinity-slabs -> CSV with slab_id, affinity, pinned_fraction, prefix_density. helps SREs tune thresholds.
sana: perf plan: simulate 200 tenants with mixed tiny alloc/pinned long lived ranges. run baseline (global waves) vs affinity+tokens+rewarm. measure host_frag, cpu_compact_seconds, p95 gen latency.
nico: owner assignments: I'll draft RFC for affinity scorer + token model, sana will mock token APIs in allocator, anya will add runtime prefix_density hook and rewarm receiver, kevin will add debug endpoint. aim to prototype in staging in ~7-10 days.
frag-bot: snapshot created: affinity-token-probe by nico at 1743210000
nico: thanks all. keep initial API surface tiny so we can iterate: allocator.compact_hint(tenant, urgency) and allocator.query_top_affinity(N).
kevin: +1. ping me when RFC is up.
